data.name: Emilina
data.long_meaning: The name Emilina is derived from the Latin name Aemiliana. It is a combination of the names Emma and Lina. Emma means 'universal' or 'whole' in Germanic languages, and Lina means 'flexible' or 'soft' in Latin. In Christian tradition, the name Emilina represents the strength and flexibility of the Virgin Mary.
